promotion: none (no signing, no registry, no champion change)

amendment.a0_exposure: the A0 run COMPUTED PRESAMPLE outcomes (selected arms of S1/S2/S3 and both S5 arms), PRINTED the S1-S3 PRESAMPLE summaries in its job log, SAVED them in its artifact and DISPLAYED the primary table in its job summary. Whether anyone viewed them cannot be determined from the GitHub API. PRESAMPLE is therefore recorded as EXPOSED (outcomes published, unread by the analyst), not as untouched
amendment.cause: pre-run adversarial reviews (the analyst's, then three independent reviews of execution/controls/book, statistics/protocol and data): unselected arms simulated on PRESAMPLE before being discarded (S1-S3) or published (S5); the decision rule over-rejected on production-shaped nulls; missing bars could hide stops; corporate actions could silently be unavailable and mis-adjusted splits went undetected; S5 benchmark mis-timed on rebalance days; Holm dropped members without a p-value; the UNCERTAINTY rule differed between the copies; FAILED_WITH_POWER ignored the optimistic leg; touch-fill sensitivity covered buy limits only; a delayed PRESAMPLE time exit could reach DEV; the S3 retest of an older breakout could be hidden by a newer one; S5 had no cost, regime or MDE gates
amendment.thresholds_changed: none (alpha, block lengths, minimum blocks, economic minimums, costs and arms unchanged)
amendment.timing: issued before any protocol-2 outcome informed it. The analyst never saw an A0 outcome value: of the A0 run (Actions run 39829472789, cancelled after its study step had finished) only file names, sizes, hashes and a redacted structural scan (line counts, key presence) were examined

arm_selection.criterion: largest DEV studentized paired difference (pessimistic, 25 bps, vs the generic matched control; the smaller t of L = 20 and 40); arms whose DEV test is not OK are not eligible; none eligible -> the default arm; ties -> earlier in the arm list
arm_selection.isolation: A1: (1) signals from causal features; (2) every registered S1-S5 arm evaluated on DEV only; (3) the frozen rule picks one arm per strategy and the choice is hashed (selection lock, logged before any PRESAMPLE outcome); (4) PRESAMPLE is simulated for the locked arms only. An unselected arm is never simulated on PRESAMPLE, so no PRESAMPLE outcome of it exists to reach a metric, log or artifact. S5 simulates each segment from the rebalance row preceding it. Legacy rules, baselines and engine self-checks are single configurations and run after the lock
arm_selection.presample: only the selected arm decides; other arms are not used for any status
arm_selection.s5_criterion: S5 has no matched control: its arms are ranked by the smaller DEV t (L = 20 and 40) of the daily active return vs exposure-matched SPY/cash (A1, registering what the code does)

books.benchmark_approximation: SPY close-to-close with the previous close's exposure; intraday entries and exits are not timed (descriptive only)
books.control_book_window: every book runs to the latest exit of the strategy and control trades of the segment
books.sector_cap_basis: open positions at their previous-close mark (A1; A0 used entry cost)

dev.use: arm selection, variance and minimum-detectable-effect estimates, diagnostics; never a verdict

presample.decisions: from the first session with 252 prior sessions to the last whose decision + 22 sessions is before 2019-10-23
presample.evidence_type: PRESAMPLE_BACKWARD_TIME_HISTORICAL_ROBUSTNESS (earlier in time than the design data; not forward out-of-sample; A0 outcomes published unread)
presample.label_exclusion: a PRESAMPLE trade or control whose exit session (either leg) is on or after 2019-10-23 is excluded (a delayed time exit could otherwise reach DEV)
presample.role: EVALUATION_PRESAMPLE_EXPOSED_A0_UNREAD_BY_ANALYST (untouched by protocol-1 and by design; A0 run 39829472789 published outcomes on 2026-10-22, see amendment.a0_exposure)

controls.geometry: signal's stop distance in ATR (live 1-3 ATR clamp), same target rule and policy
controls.value: per-signal net return at the primary cost; a no-fill counts 0 for strategy and control

data.integrity_checks: A1: corporate actions must be available (else SOURCE_INVALID) and their per-year coverage is reported; a split ex-date whose split-adjusted close jumps > 25% is adjustment-suspect and quarantined; impossible bars (open or close outside [low, high]) are removed and become missing sessions; SPY must have every session (its dates are the session axis) and a median volume >= 20M shares (consolidated, not one venue)
data.max_requests_scope: A1: enforced by the adapter on EVERY provider call (bars and corporate actions together); exhaustion stops the run before any evaluation; a repeated page token stops it as SOURCE_INVALID

dispositions.FAILED_WITH_POWER: clusters OK, mean <= 0, and the largest one-sided 95% upper bound < the economic minimum; when the legs differ, the optimistic leg must meet the same two conditions (A1)
dispositions.NOT_EVALUABLE_MISSING_INPUT: required point-in-time input does not exist (S4, H3, H7)
dispositions.RESEARCH_ENGINE_INVALID: an engine self-check failed; no strategy status is reported
dispositions.RULE_ECONOMICALLY_PROMISING_REQUIRES_FOR: clusters OK, paired mean > 0 and absolute mean > 0, not validated
dispositions.RULE_VALIDATED_RESEARCH_OOS: PRESAMPLE, selected arm: clusters OK; Holm p < 0.05; mean >= economic minimum; absolute per-signal mean > 0 at 25 bps; paired mean > 0 at 50 bps and with touch-fill sensitivity; positive in both PRESAMPLE halves; >= 2 regime labels with >= 15% of signals each; DEV paired mean > 0; ambiguous trades <= 25% of fills. Research only: the forward shadow is still required
dispositions.UNCERTAINTY_TOO_HIGH: every validation gate passes on the optimistic leg only, or ambiguous trades > 25% of fills. A1 reading (this machine copy governs): clusters OK and not validated, and either ambiguous trades > 25% of fills (whatever the other gates), or the legs differ and every validation gate passes on the optimistic leg, with its Holm p recomputed by entering the optimistic p in the family
dispositions.aggregate: NO_TRADE unless at least one RULE_VALIDATED_RESEARCH_OOS; even then RESEARCH_ONLY with live alerts disabled until the forward shadow and the release gates pass
dispositions.decision_legs: the decision value is strategy pessimistic minus controls pessimistic ('both legs pessimistic'); what daily bars can bound, [strategy pessimistic - controls optimistic, strategy optimistic - controls pessimistic], and the controls' ambiguous share are reported descriptively (A1)
dispositions.order: A1: the first rule that holds, in this order: clusters not OK -> INCONCLUSIVE; every gate -> VALIDATED; ambiguous > 25% -> UNCERTAINTY; optimistic leg passes every gate -> UNCERTAINTY; FAILED_WITH_POWER; RULE_ECONOMICALLY_PROMISING_REQUIRES_FORWARD; INCONCLUSIVE

economic_min_effect.note: +0.30 pp per 20-session signal (paired); +1 bp per day for S5

engine_self_checks.lookahead_trap: a deliberately cheating rule (each session, the eligible member with the top realized forward 20-session return; E0X1, 2 ATR stop) must give conservative p < 0.001 on PRESAMPLE; it is never a strategy
engine_self_checks.placebo: each session one random eligible member, same execution: reported; p < 0.01 raises a warning

execution.dedup: one pending/open position per (strategy, arm, symbol) until the pessimistic exit

entry_arms.E0: limit at entry_max, open guard entry_min (protocol-1 zone)
entry_arms.E1: limit 0.5 ATR below the decision close, open guard one tick above the stop

exit_arms.X0: stop + target (2R, capped below the 120-session high) + time exit
exit_arms.X2: trailing stop: highest close through d-1 minus 3 ATR(d-1)

execution.levels: signals.levels.compute_levels at the PRIMARY cost (25 bps). X0 arms: target capped below the prior 120-session high and screened at min_net_rr 1.5. X1/X2 arms have no target: only the stop must be valid
execution.missing_bars: A1: a missing session while held is ambiguity MISSING_BAR (legs: the worst and best of stop that day at min(stop, next valid open), target that day for X0, or continue); an entry window without any bar is NO_DATA_IN_ENTRY_WINDOW (an incomplete label, excluded), not a no-fill; MISSING_BAR counts in the ambiguous share
execution.price_grid: derived prices (limit - trade-through, target + trade-through, stop + one tick) are compared on the cent grid
execution.touch_fill_sensitivity_scope: the price must trade through by 1 tick for resting buy limits AND target sell limits; the re-simulated windows are quarantined like the primary ones

inference.decision_statistic: conservative: largest p and smallest lower bound over L = 20 and 40 (the Bartlett adjacent-block term covers dependence beyond the 22-session label); L = 60 is reported as a sensitivity because a 684-session window has at most 12 such blocks
inference.method: inference-v2.1: studentized, null-centred circular block bootstrap on the session index
inference.multiplicity_missing_p: a family member without a p-value enters Holm with p = 1, so the family size stays 4 (the same rule applies to the legacy family)
inference.small_sample_t_floor_rule: A1: at each block length the p-value is the larger of the bootstrap-t p and the Student-t p with df = non-empty blocks - 1, and the bounds use the wider quantile. Reason: on production-shaped synthetic nulls (bench/qv2_a1_production_null_battery.py, 3,000 replicates each: K = 10 same-session controls, residual style/beta exposure, clustered signals) the A0 rule rejected 5.9-7.9% at nominal 5% and 1.7-2.4% at the Holm first-step level 1.25%; with the floor 5.8-6.6% and 1.6-1.9%. The residual over-size (about 1.2-1.5x nominal) is DISCLOSED, not fixed: alpha is unchanged, and a Holm p between 0.03 and 0.05 is reported as borderline
inference.time_axis: per segment, the sessions on which the live gates admit at least one stock (the market-wide risk-off breaker closes all stocks; a closed market is not missing evidence); S5 uses every session

legacy.family: legacy comparators (own Holm family; never affect S statuses)

protocol.minimum_detectable_effect: reported per strategy: (z(1 - 0.05/4) + z(0.80)) x SE, with SE from DEV projected to the PRESAMPLE sample size and with the realised PRESAMPLE SE (largest over the decision block lengths); S5 per day

quarantine.rule: a trade (strategy or control) whose FIXED label window [decision session, decision + 2 + 20 sessions] (extended to a later, delayed exit) contains a spin-off ex-date of its symbol is excluded; a control is replaced by the next candidate. A1: the window no longer depends on the realised exit, so the quarantine never selects on the outcome

protocol.registered: 2026-10-22, before any protocol-2 outcome was computed on market data
protocol.reporting: descriptive economics (win/loss distribution, exit shares, gross and net per fill, net per initial signal, books, concentration, independent counts) never change a disposition; values on fewer than 30 trades are flagged small_sample

S1.mechanism_pool: leaders (S1 leader condition at t, any pullback state)
S1.title: Leadership continuation after a controlled pullback

S3.mechanism: per opportunity: retest arm minus immediate arm, same exit
S3.mechanism_scope: DEV only (A1 isolation): the contrast needs both entry arms, so its PRESAMPLE half would evaluate an unselected arm and is withheld; descriptive, never a gate; an opportunity whose retest lies outside the breakout's segment or whose trade is quarantined or label-incomplete is excluded, not counted as a miss
S3.retest_rule: each qualified breakout b is judged on its own window b+1..b+3 (first qualifying session); when two opportunities retest on one session the signal carries the more recent breakout
S3.title: Volatility-contraction breakout: immediate vs retest

S4.reason: no verified point-in-time first-publication earnings source; nothing is backdated
S4.title: First-publication earnings/guidance continuation

S5.benchmark: exposure-matched SPY/cash: per session (1 + prior-close exposure x SPY overnight return) x (1 + post-open exposure x SPY open-to-close return) - 1; cash yield 0; no cost
S5.gates: Holm p < 0.05; mean daily active >= +1 bp; mean daily net > 0 at 25 bps; mean daily active > 0 at 50 bps; positive in both PRESAMPLE halves; >= 2 regime labels with >= 15% of invested sessions; DEV mean > 0. Exempt: touch-fill and daily-bar ambiguity (market orders at the open)
S5.presample: only the DEV-selected arm is computed on PRESAMPLE
S5.price_only_bias: dividends are not modelled: a yield gap of about 1%/yr between the held ETFs and SPY moves the daily active return by about 0.4 bp x exposure (economic minimum: +1 bp/day)
S5.risk_off_check: regime abstention is evaluated at rebalance sessions only
S5.title: Sector-ETF trend allocation with cash abstention

universe.comparator: U0 = the fixed66 stocks, reported as a descriptive subset
universe.gates: live GateConfig defaults (price >= 10, median dollar volume >= 30M, avg volume >= 1M shares, >= 180 bars, extension <= 3.5 ATR, risk-off breaker 0.6); earnings unknown (no point-in-time calendar)
universe.membership_rule: a stock is a member at t only if its date_added <= t; ranks and breadth use members only
universe.references: SPY and the 11 SPDR sector ETFs; S1-S3 and legacy rules never trade them; S5 trades the ETFs
universe.share_classes: one listing per SEC CIK (first in snapshot order)
universe.u2_point_in_time: BLOCKED_PIT_UNIVERSE: no freely licensed, verified point-in-time S&P 500 membership with persistent security ids and delisted price history is available to this repository

corporate_actions.limitation: records are requested for current U1 tickers: a spin-off by a parent under a former ticker may be absent; parents not in U1 are listed above

source.entitlement: Alpaca Basic: historical SIP older than 15 minutes

warnings: SURVIVORSHIP: U1 = current S&P 500 constituents (snapshot 2026-10-22); members that left the index are absent. Eligibility starts at each member's date_added, which removes later additions from earlier cross-sections but not the survivor effect; paired same-date controls from the same member set partly cancel it
SECTOR LABELS: current GICS sectors applied to all history (the 2018 communication services reclassification)
EARNINGS UNKNOWN: no point-in-time earnings calendar; S4 is NOT_EVALUABLE and earnings vetoes are not modelled
PRICE-ONLY RETURNS: split-adjusted bars, dividends not modelled (affects absolute, much less paired, returns)
DAILY BARS: intraday order is unknown; ambiguous outcomes carry pessimistic and optimistic legs (exec-v2.1); a missing session while held is an ambiguity too
PRESAMPLE IS EARLIER, NOT LATER: the evaluation window precedes the design data (backward-time historical robustness, not forward out-of-sample); forward evidence is still required

PRESAMPLE EXPOSURE: the cancelled A0 run 39829472789 computed and published PRESAMPLE outcomes (job log, job summary, artifact). The analyst never read them and no design choice responded to them, but the window is not untouched; read every PRESAMPLE result with that in mind (PROTOCOL_V2.md section 12)
SURVIVORSHIP-LIMITED UNIVERSE: U1 is not an unbiased all-market sample; results do not generalise to delisted or smaller stocks

INFERENCE SIZE: on production-shaped synthetic nulls the decision rule (with the A1 Student-t floor) rejects 5.8-6.6% at nominal 5% and 1.6-1.9% at the Holm first step (nominal 1.25%); dependence beyond the block length (slowly varying factor premia) is not fully covered, so a Holm p between 0.03 and 0.05 is borderline evidence

LARGE MINIMUM DETECTABLE EFFECT: on production-shaped synthetic panels the PRESAMPLE window detects only about +1.5-2 pp per signal at 80% power (5-7x the +0.30 pp economic minimum); a true edge at the economic minimum will most likely read INCONCLUSIVE, and any VALIDATED effect size is likely inflated (winner's curse)
SPLIT ADJUSTMENT: 2 symbol(s) show a >25% jump on a split ex-date; those trade windows are quarantined
CORPORATE ACTIONS BY CURRENT TICKER: a spin-off by a parent under a former ticker may be missing from the quarantine; dividends and other distributions are not modelled
